title: A growing thought and unfamiliar perspective

captions.physics: Reflecting on observations and sharing conclusions
captions.emotions: Feeling held up by changed perspective

meaning: Your shared view can gain new substance even when moving to another perspective initially feels like being held up.
text: A new thought sometimes requires leaving a familiar way of seeing. The Hermit in the physical position of Ajna suggests reflecting on observations and sharing a conclusion. The Empress in energy supports wanting understanding to grow from concrete observations. The Hanged Man in emotions feels held up as perspective changes. You may both find a new explanation interesting while still struggling to place it alongside the earlier one internally. Your shared view gains substance, while a sense of temporary suspension accompanies moving to another angle.

Suppose you examine a staircase photographed from above. The steps initially look like a projecting pattern. After considering the light carefully, one of you explains how the image shows a descent. **A substantial thought can arrive before clarity feels familiar.** You both understand the explanation, yet the image still seems to change shape. You want to linger between the readings. Interest in the material remains: different lines and shadows start finding new places although looking at them still feels unfamiliar.

The risk is demanding immediate ease from a new thought and treating hesitation as evidence of an unsuccessful explanation. Discussion returns to the initial image before another angle has emerged. Wanting understanding to grow preserves room for transition: a substantial conclusion is already accessible to both while its unfamiliar appearance still needs attention.
